summary: Shivansh Charak is a software engineer and database systems specialist focused on scalable backend infrastructure, hybrid search engine design, and multi-tenant architectures. Holding a Bachelor of Science in Computer Science from Vishwakarma University, he engineers production-grade Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines and distributed services at Foundry AI. His work centers on leveraging PostgreSQL for high-throughput enterprise knowledge retrieval, vector indexing, and integrating modern AI frameworks like PydanticAI.
